sentences.en: He is involved in working out a crossword puzzle.
sentences.zh: 他正在做纵横填字游戏。

sentences.en: Which crossword do you like better, American-style or Swedish-style?
sentences.zh: 你喜欢哪种纵横填字游戏，美式风格的还是瑞典风格的？

sentences.en: I give up! I can't solve this crossword puzzle.
sentences.zh: 放弃吧！我解不开这个纵横填字游戏。

senses.zh: 纵横字谜；纵横填字谜（等于cross puzzle）
